author: tincmetals98
body:
That's great.

Upgrades are finding more world bosses for an above normal weapon, Undead Golem would bring in a Bonecrusher. Troll for Troll charm. If you want more Att, you could also do Arena for some arrows or wait a few levels till next tier. Same goes for Accessories, you could use Platinum Amulets next Tier if you want more Att.

Next tier opens up Sandstorm or Vampiric Blade. Dark Elf gear. Dark Elves are rare till T5, but one shows up T4 with T5 gear. T5 you can grab a Mirror from Arena for a lot more mana. Till then find or build a player shop to Level 4+ for a Whisper to buy for a strong offense.

Now I highly recommend getting Rogue class for Flurry as the earliest Multi-Hit and using it on Paladin. However, since you're almost 75 you can get Tricut on Battle Master. Still consider buying T1 Mage, Thief and T2 Rogue, Archmage. This will help fulfill achievements that will net you more orns than you spend to get those classes.

Edited Addition:

Look for Arcanist and buy Pommel Strike. It's for when you need a cheap attack that does Physical Dmg even if your weapon is Elemental. An element on your weapon that matches your Faction (ergo Fire for Inferno) will increase your damage by 20% - if you don't mind the resistances. That or keep your faction's element as a Strike in your attack list. I recommend at least at your tier to have Earth Strike available to one shot Flames, Armors, and Magma Golems.

author: Elf_Sunmoon
body: Mate, really don't bother with gears at that lvl, you gonna find new weapon to wear every 2 days.. When you hit lvl 200+ you would stuck with a single piece for a whole year. Just put anything that give you more stats and dmg and you are good to go and then grind like a modafaka to lvl up.

author: Nostromozx
body: In the earlier tiers, your primary weapon is the most valuable piece. An good ornate weapon can last a couple tiers. Other pieces will get out of date before you have the resources to upgrade them very far.

author: [deleted]
body: Just remember that ornate from a tier below is better than ordinary from your current tier. Legendary might be the cutoff.

author: PsdoOrna
body:
Looks good for your tier.

KEEP IN MIND! 
Gear is swapped constantly until around level 200-225. Lower gear is swapped out VERY frequently so don’t worry about it much.

author: Majin_Kaiser
body: I have always auto broke down everything lower than legendary, and started upgrading it till I found something better. Yeah, it's a week later when that Sandstorm comes out. However, it was ornate, so it will still be relevant for a couple tiers. Great build though. I remember my first Annkh. It was actually the last normal I used. Found a legendary after that, and never went back.
